title: Durable Medical Equipment Rentals: Rental Caps, Title and Purchase Options by Class
content:
The rental cap is the number of paid rental months after which rental payments stop, and for Durable Medical Equipment Rentals it is set per payment class together with whether ownership passes to the patient at the cap, whether a purchase option is offered, and how long the supplier keeps furnishing the item afterwards without rental payment.

## Class table

| Payment class | Rental cap (paid rental months) | Ownership passes to the patient at the cap | Rental month of the purchase option | Patient may decline the purchase option and keep renting | Months the supplier keeps furnishing without rental payment after the cap |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Inexpensive or Routinely Purchased Equipment | 10 | Yes | 0 (no purchase option) | No | 0 (none) |
| Capped Rental Equipment | 13 | Yes | 0 (no purchase option) | No | 0 (none) |
| Continuous Positive Airway Pressure Equipment | 13 | Yes | 0 (no purchase option) | No | 0 (none) |
| Power Mobility Device | 13 | Yes | 1 | Yes | 0 (none) |
| Oxygen and Oxygen Equipment | 36 | No | 0 (no purchase option) | No | 24 |
| Frequently Serviced Equipment | 0 (no cap) | No | 0 (no purchase option) | No | 0 (none) |
| Customized Equipment | 0 (no cap) | No | 0 (no purchase option) | No | 0 (none) |

How the figures read: a cap of 0 means the class has no rental cap; a purchase-option month of 0 means no purchase option is offered; a continued-furnishing figure of 0 means no months of furnishing without rental payment.

## The same figures, grouped

- **Capped classes whose title passes to the patient at the cap:** Inexpensive or Routinely Purchased Equipment (cap 10), Capped Rental Equipment (cap 13), Continuous Positive Airway Pressure Equipment (cap 13) and Power Mobility Device (cap 13).
- **Capped class that stays supplier-owned:** Oxygen and Oxygen Equipment, capped at 36 paid rental months, after which the supplier keeps furnishing the item for 24 months without rental payment.
- **Classes with no cap:** Frequently Serviced Equipment, which stays supplier-owned, and Customized Equipment, which is not rented.
- **Purchase option:** offered only in Power Mobility Device, in rental month 1, and only that class allows the patient to decline the option and keep renting.

## Questions answered from the table

**Does an Oxygen and Oxygen Equipment concentrator pass to the patient after 36 paid rental months?** No. Ownership does not pass at the cap in that class; the supplier keeps furnishing the item for 24 months without rental payment.

**In which rental month is a Power Mobility Device purchase option offered?** Rental month 1.

**Is there a number of paid months after which Frequently Serviced Equipment stops being paid?** No. The class has no cap (0).
